description: This Java class 'CommandWithOptionalEntityValidator' implements a validation function that checks commands which modify entities, ensuring they do not contain harmful JSON data, such as null characters, before processing downstream.

classes.name: CommandWithOptionalEntityValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates commands with optional entities to prevent harmful JSON data, particularly null characters, from being processed.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes validation on the provided WithDittoHeaders object, returning it if valid or throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: checkForHarmfulEntity
methods.description: Checks whether the headers contain a command with an entity that has illegal JSON content.

methods.name: isJsonValueIllegal
methods.description: Recursively checks if a JsonValue contains illegal characters or structures, such as null characters.

methods.name: isJsonFieldIllegal
methods.description: Checks if a JsonField's key or value contains illegal content.

methods.name: isStringIllegal
methods.description: Detects null characters within a string.

methods.name: buildError
methods.description: Constructs and throws a detailed JSON parsing exception indicating illegal JSON content.
